versions.changelog: - ezBookkeeping skills and API tokens no longer support revoking other tokens
- Update the parameter descriptions for the account and transaction category APIs
- Add more detailed descriptions for the amount field of creating transaction API

- Added Windows PowerShell API tools script: scripts/ebktools.ps1
- Enables Windows users to access all ezBookkeeping API Tools functions via PowerShell
- Removed use of eval in posix scripts
- Added metadata to specify environment variable requirements

- This SKILL includes all required scripts and does not download them from the official repository. Future script updates will be synchronized with this SKILL. If you are using Windows, you must manually download ebktools.ps1 from the ezBookkeeping official repository into the SKILL scripts directory.

- Initial release of ezBookkeeping skill.
- Enables AI agents to add and query transactions, accounts, categories, and tags via the ezBookkeeping API Tools.
- Instructions for installing and using the API Tools on Linux, macOS, and Windows included.
- Details on required environment variables for configuration.
